say:1:1121218001:0.text: She hits hard! No wonder she's Illucia's daughter. Pretty sure I've got a broken rib or two.
say:1:1121218001:0.source_cn: 这姑娘下手可真狠，不愧是黑金女士的女儿，我的肋骨可能断...

say:2:1121218002:1.text: ... Is she really her daughter? Look closely at her wings.
say:2:1121218002:1.source_cn: 她真是那人的女儿吗？你们仔细看她的翅膀。

say:3:1121218003:1.text: Hm... You're right, they don't look that similar.
say:3:1121218003:1.source_cn: 嗯……从外貌来看，确实和黑金女士不怎么像。

choice_prompt:4:1121218003.text: Hm... You're right, they don't look that similar.
choice_prompt:4:1121218003.source_cn: 嗯……从外貌来看，确实和黑金女士不怎么像。

say:5:1121218004:0.text: I don't know much about the Maulers, but she seems too slim and lithe to be one.
say:5:1121218004:0.source_cn: 我对蛮血部落的了解不算特别多，但她的身形纤细轻盈，不太像。

say:7:1121218009:0.text: So then why would she refer to Illucia as "Mother"?
say:7:1121218009:0.source_cn: 所以她为什么会把黑金女士称为母亲呢？

say:11:1121218011:0.text: No, I am Mother's only true daughter. My earliest memories are of her smile.
say:11:1121218011:0.source_cn: 不，我是妈妈唯一的亲女儿，我最早的记忆便是妈妈的笑脸。

say:12:1121218012:1.text: Then I can't help but wonder about your father.
say:12:1121218012:1.source_cn: 那我不禁要好奇你父亲的身份了。

say:16:1121218016:0.source_cn: 你不理解父亲这个词语吗？

say:18:1121218018:1.text: They called you "Aves 11" before. Is that your code name?
say:18:1121218018:1.source_cn: 刚才那些人称呼你为阿尔法十一，这是你的代号？

say:20:1121218020:1.text: That doesn't sound like a proper name.
say:20:1121218020:1.source_cn: 这可不像什么正经名字。

say:21:1121218021:0.text: It's a good name. Mother picked it out for me.

say:22:1121218022:1.text: What a strange girl... She's hurt a lot of people, but something doesn't seem right here. Let's take her back to General Hogan.
say:22:1121218022:1.source_cn: 真是个奇怪的女孩……她伤了不少人，我们先把她带回圣石镇...

say:25:1121218007:1.text: You must be joking. The eyes of a Graveborn glow with a pale green light. Her eyes are normal.
say:25:1121218007:1.source_cn: 你又在开玩笑，我知道亡灵眷族的眼瞳里烁动着幽幽绿光。她...
say:25:1121218007:1.male: You must be joking. The eyes of a Graveborn glow with a pale green light. Her eyes are normal.
say:25:1121218007:1.female: You must be joking. The eyes of a Graveborn glow with a pale green light. Her eyes are normal.

say:26:1121218008:1.text: Honestly, she looks more like a Wilder.
say:26:1121218008:1.source_cn: 看她的气质，倒是像绿裔联盟的人。

say:0:1121219001:0.text: Hopefully, she won't cause any trouble on the way back to Holistone.
say:0:1121219001:0.source_cn: 回圣石镇吧，但愿这姑娘不会在路上闹出什么乱子。

say:1:1121220001:0.text: Let go of me... I can walk by myself!

say:2:1121220002:0.text: If you hadn't tried to escape several times already, I wouldn't have to do this.
say:2:1121220002:0.source_cn: 姑娘，要不是你一路上好几次想要逃跑，我也不至于这么对你。

say:5:1121220003:0.text: Valen, you've returned. Seems like you've brought someone along...
say:5:1121220003:0.source_cn: 维伦，你们回来了，看样子有所收获。

say:6:1121220004:1.text: General, you won't believe it... We captured Illucia's daughter.
say:6:1121220004:1.source_cn: 将军，你一定想不到，我们抓住了黑金女士的女儿。

say:9:1121220006:1.text: To be precise, she claims to be Illucia's daughter, but we have doubts about her true origins.
say:9:1121220006:1.source_cn: 准确来说……她自称是黑金女士的女儿，我认为她的身份还有...

say:10:1121220007:1.text: As you can see, she appears to be of Wilder descent.
say:10:1121220007:1.source_cn: 如各位所见，她的长相更像是绿裔联盟的人。

say:11:1121220008:1.source_cn: 蕾米雅，你也这么认为吧？

say:19:1121220012:2.text: Could it be...? No, that would be impossible.
say:19:1121220012:2.source_cn: 是阿露拉吗……不对，她不可能出现在这里，是我认错了。

say:21:1121220013:0.text: Name... That name just now, who does it belong to?
say:21:1121220013:0.source_cn: 名字……\n刚才那个名字，是谁的？

say:23:1121220015:0.text: Because I've heard that name in my dreams many, many times.
say:23:1121220015:0.source_cn: 因为那个名字在我的梦中出现过，出现了很多很多次。

say:24:1121220016:0.text: I... want to know who owns that name.

say:25:1121220017:0.text: Well, that's too bad. From where I stand, we're enemies.
say:25:1121220017:0.source_cn: 不告诉你哦。从现在的立场来说，我们可是敌人。

say:30:1121220019:0.text: Take this girl and keep her under strict guard.
say:30:1121220019:0.source_cn: 来人，先把这位姑娘带下去，严加看管。

say:35:1121220021:0.text: Hey! My name's Lenya. No silly nicknames, got it?
say:35:1121220021:0.source_cn: 打住！我叫蕾米雅，不要随便给我取外号。

say:36:1121220022:0.text: If I don't run away, will you tell me about the owner of that name?
say:36:1121220022:0.source_cn: 如果我不逃走，你会告诉我吗？告诉我那个名字的主人。

say:1:1121222001:0.text: So, it's pretty obvious that whoever this Laura is looks uncannily similar to Aves 11.
say:1:1121222001:0.source_cn: 依我看，蕾米雅小姐好像认识一个叫做阿露拉的人，而且，那...

say:2:1121222002:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一？奇怪的名字……

say:3:1121222003:0.text: Laura is a friend of mine I met while training in the Vaduso Mountains.
say:3:1121222003:0.source_cn: 正如维伦先生猜的那样。阿露拉是我以前在瓦度索山脉修行时...

say:4:1121222004:0.text: But hey, maybe I'm the only one who thinks we're friends, because I tend to be pretty forward.
say:4:1121222004:0.source_cn: 不过，也可能只有我把人家当朋友啦，因为我是个自来熟嘛。

say:6:1121222005:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think of Laura's connection to Aves 11?
say:6:1121222005:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think of Laura's connection to Aves 11?
say:6:1121222005:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think of Laura's connection to Aves 11?

choice_prompt:7:1121222005.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think of Laura's connection to Aves 11?
choice_prompt:7:1121222005.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think of Laura's connection to Aves 11?

say:8:1121222006:0.text: As far as I know, Laura doesn't have any sisters.
say:8:1121222006:0.source_cn: 阿露拉没有姐妹，这我还是知道的。

say:9:1121222009:0.text: Illucia specializes in dark magic. Perhaps she used some foul technique to wipe Laura's memory.
say:9:1121222009:0.source_cn: 那位黑金女士擅长黑魔法，也许她用某种污秽的术式，让阿露...

say:10:1121222010:0.text: Lenya, can you reach Laura? Can we send a wind message?
say:10:1121222010:0.source_cn: 蕾米雅，你能联系上阿露拉吗？能否拜托风语者给她传信？

say:11:1121222011:0.text: If I could find her, I'd tell you. But she's been off the grid, and I'm clueless about her whereabouts.
say:11:1121222011:0.source_cn: 要是能联系上，我早就告诉你了。她一直在隐居，我并不知道...

say:15:1121222012:0.text: General Hogan! We've captured the escaped Adamant Syndicate members!
say:15:1121222012:0.source_cn: 霍根将军！我们抓住了逃跑的黑金残党！

say:17:1121222013:2.text: Get your dirty hands off me, you filthy knights! We were trained by Illucia herself! We'd rather die than give in!
say:17:1121222013:2.source_cn: 把你的脏手拿开！虚伪的骑士！我们可是伊露西卡女士培养的...

say:18:1121222014:2.text: Hurry up and take my life! Just like you did with Aves 11!
say:18:1121222014:2.source_cn: 赶紧拿走我的性命吧！就像你们对阿尔法十一做的那样！

say:21:1121222015:0.text: That's quite an assumption. We did not harm the girl.
say:21:1121222015:0.source_cn: 你猜错了，我们没有伤害那姑娘。

say:22:1121222016:0.text: Her origins are highly suspicious, and I'm quite sure you have information in this regard. Share what you know, and I'll consider a lighter sentence.
say:22:1121222016:0.source_cn: 她的身份疑点重重，想必你们知道内情。如果你愿意提供情报...

say:23:1121222017:0.text: You want me to betray Illucia? Not a chance!
say:23:1121222017:0.source_cn: 哼，想让我背叛伊露西卡女士？门都没有！

say:24:1121222018:0.text: That little bird is a blade that Illucia has been honing for years. Your lies and flowery words won't sway her either!
say:24:1121222018:0.source_cn: 那小鸟是一把刀，伊露西卡女士用了心血将她打磨锋利，别以...

say:27:1121222019:0.text: What's in that pocket of yours?
say:27:1121222019:0.source_cn: ……我说，你那鼓囊囊的口袋里装着什么？

say:29:1121222021:0.text: You're not going into the cell with a bag of tricks... Let's see what you've got.
say:29:1121222021:0.source_cn: 我可不会让你带着行囊进地牢，交出来。

say:31:1121222023:0.text: Hmph, you think I can't get it from you?
say:31:1121222023:0.source_cn: 嘿，你不交我就拿不着吗？

say:38:1121222026:2.text: Give that back, you damn thief!

say:39:1121222027:1.text: Hm. Some sort of stone carving?

say:42:1121222028:0.text: This craftsmanship... There's no doubt that this carving came from the Vaduso Mountains.
say:42:1121222028:0.source_cn: 这工艺……\n错不了，这石雕来自瓦度索山脉。

say:43:1121222029:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate swindled a lot of goods out of the locals, and this was likely one of them.
say:43:1121222029:0.source_cn: 黑金商会从当地居民那骗走了不少东西，这个可能也是赃物。

say:45:1121222030:1.text: Is the design on the carving a small bird? Could it be referring to the whole "Aves 11" thing?
say:45:1121222030:1.source_cn: 石雕上刻的图案是小鸟吗？这会不会是那个阿尔法十一的东西？

say:48:1121222031:0.text: That belongs to Illucia! Give it back!
say:48:1121222031:0.source_cn: 这是伊露西卡女士的！还给我！

say:49:1121222032:0.text: We'll find out one way or another. I'll bring Aves 11 in.
say:49:1121222032:0.source_cn: 究竟是不是，一问便知。我会把阿尔法十一叫来对质。

say:51:1121222007:0.text: No way. If she had a kid, they'd be hanging out with the other tiny tots at Florabelle's.
say:51:1121222007:0.source_cn: 不可能吧。她要是有女儿，顶多和芙拉贝尔那里的孩子们一般大。

choice:7:2:3.text: They must be the same person!
choice:7:2:3.male: They must be the same person!
choice:7:2:3.female: They must be the same person!

say:2:1121223002:0.text: Actually, we brought something for you.
say:2:1121223002:0.source_cn: 别着急。在那之前，有个东西，需要你确认。

say:4:1121223004:0.text: This is... Why... I don't understand...

say:7:1121223006:0.text: This is the first time I've seen it.

say:8:1121223007:0.text: But I felt such warmth the moment you brought it out.
say:8:1121223007:0.source_cn: 但是，看到它的一瞬间，身体变得很温暖。

say:9:1121223008:0.text: What's happening? Ever since I met you my world has been spinning.
say:9:1121223008:0.source_cn: 为什么呢……遇到你们以后，我的问题越来越多了。

say:13:1121223009:0.text: Perhaps only when we reach the Vaduso Mountains will our speculations be confirmed.
say:13:1121223009:0.source_cn: 或许只有到了瓦度索山脉，我们的种种猜想才能得到证实。

say:15:1121223011:1.text: You have permission to take Aves 11 out of Holistone.
say:15:1121223011:1.source_cn: 好吧，我允许你们带阿尔法十一离开圣石镇。

say:17:1121223013:1.text: Lyca, if she truly is a Wilder, you are well within your rights to take over this matter.
say:17:1121223013:1.source_cn: 莱卡小姐，假如她真的属于绿裔联盟，你们有权接管此事。

say:18:1121223014:1.text: Illucia may have used dark magic to manipulate her, and she should not be punished until the truth is revealed.
say:18:1121223014:1.source_cn: 黑金女士可能用了黑魔法操纵她，在弄清真相前，她不该被惩罚。

say:20:1121223016:1.text: As for the sculpture, I think Aves 11 should hold onto it for the time being.
say:20:1121223016:1.source_cn: 至于这个石雕。我看，暂时交给阿尔法十一吧。

say:23:1121223017:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，它有可能是你的，希望你能好好保管。

say:24:1121223018:0.text: Why would you trust your enemy?

say:25:1121223019:0.text: I don't trust my enemies... but I would like to have more friends of the forest.
say:25:1121223019:0.source_cn: 我并不相信敌人，但我愿意相信来自丛林的朋友。

say:26:1121223020:0.text: Your words, I don't quite understand them... but I'll accept this sculpture.
say:26:1121223020:0.source_cn: 你的话，我不太懂。不过……我愿意保管它。

say:29:1121223021:0.text: Sweet! I'll shoot Arden a message and fill him in. Arden knows Laura.
say:29:1121223021:0.source_cn: 好吧！那我去给雅顿贤者写封信，将这边的情况告诉他，雅顿...

say:30:1121223022:0.text: I haven't agreed to go with you.
say:30:1121223022:0.source_cn: 我还没有答应要和你们走。

say:31:1121223023:0.text: So you're going to carry around that silly name forever? Aves 11...
say:31:1121223023:0.source_cn: 那你打算永远顶着那个没有感情的名字吗？阿尔法十一。

say:32:1121223024:0.text: But that's what Mother picked out for me and—

say:33:1121223025:0.text: A real mom wouldn't saddle her kid with a code name!
say:33:1121223025:0.source_cn: 真正的母亲不会取那种代号般的名字！

say:34:1121223026:0.text: Don't you want to know who Laura is? It's time I told you...
say:34:1121223026:0.source_cn: 你不是想知道阿露拉是谁的名字吗？那我告诉你好了。

say:35:1121223027:0.text: Kiddo, we believe that name belongs to you.
say:35:1121223027:0.source_cn: 我们认为，那个名字属于你。

say:0:1121224001:0.text: A boat to the Dark Forest is about to depart. There's still time to get to the dock.
say:0:1121224001:0.source_cn: 正好有一艘去薄暮丛林的船快启程了，现在去码头还来得及。

say:1:1121225001:1.text: One, two, three girls... is that it? You, mage, are you coming aboard?
say:1:1121225001:1.source_cn: 一、二、三……只有这三位姑娘乘船吗？那边的魔法师，你上不上？
say:1:1121225001:1.male: One, two, three girls... is that it? You, mage, are you coming aboard?
say:1:1121225001:1.female: One, two, three girls... is that it? You, mage, are you coming aboard?

say:3:1121225002:1.text: Alright, that makes a total of four.
say:3:1121225002:1.male: Alright, that makes a total of four.
say:3:1121225002:1.female: Alright, that makes a total of four.

say:4:1121225004:0.text: Sit back and relax, we're departing now.
say:4:1121225004:0.source_cn: 那总共是四个人，坐好吧，我们马上出发。

say:7:1121225006:0.text: What? You want off the boat?

say:8:1121225007:0.text: It's going to start pouring rain. It's dangerous to sail at this time of year.
say:8:1121225007:0.source_cn: 要下大雨了。这时候出航，有危险。

say:9:1121225008:0.text: Nonsense! It's a beautiful, sunny day.

say:10:1121225009:0.text: I'm serious. Dark clouds will come soon.
say:10:1121225009:0.source_cn: 我没有胡说，乌云很快就要来了。

say:11:1121225010:0.text: Sure, sure... Sit down if you want, or get off quickly. Time is money.
say:11:1121225010:0.source_cn: 行行行……你爱坐不坐，不坐就快下船，别耽误我挣钱。

say:16:1121225012:0.text: Looks like the rain will get heavy!

say:17:1121225013:0.text: Let's find some shelter from the rain... I don't want my fur getting all soggy.
say:17:1121225013:0.source_cn: 我们还是找个地方避避雨吧，我可不想弄湿自己的毛发。

narration:18:1121225014:1.text: A while later, the rain stops.

say:21:1121225015:0.text: Phew... This sure is a lot of rain. It's fortunate we didn't set off.
say:21:1121225015:0.source_cn: 呼，这雨真不小……幸好刚才没走。

say:22:1121225016:0.text: I'm sorry, little girl... I misjudged you.
say:22:1121225016:0.source_cn: 对不起啊小姑娘……错怪你了。

say:23:1121225017:0.text: I'm not used to hearing that word... "sorry".

say:25:1121225019:0.text: Alright, sit tight everyone. Now we're really departing.
say:25:1121225019:0.source_cn: 行吧……都坐稳咯，要出发了。

say:28:1121225020:0.text: I wish you all a safe journey!

narration:29:1121225021:0.text: Traveling by boat, you arrive at the familiar Dark Forest again.
narration:29:1121225021:0.source_cn: 坐上小船，我们再次来到了熟悉的薄暮丛林

say:32:1121225003:1.text: You're not? Please, General Hogan said he'd only feel at ease if you went along.
say:32:1121225003:1.source_cn: 你不去吗？这可伤脑筋了……将军刚才还在说呢，有你同行他...
say:32:1121225003:1.male: You're not? Please, General Hogan said he'd only feel at ease if you went along.
say:32:1121225003:1.female: You're not? Please, General Hogan said he'd only feel at ease if you went along.

choice_prompt:33:1121225003.text: You're not? Please, General Hogan said he'd only feel at ease if you went along.
choice_prompt:33:1121225003.source_cn: 你不去吗？这可伤脑筋了……将军刚才还在说呢，有你同行他才放心。
choice_prompt:33:1121225003.male: You're not? Please, General Hogan said he'd only feel at ease if you went along.
choice_prompt:33:1121225003.female: You're not? Please, General Hogan said he'd only feel at ease if you went along.

say:0:1121226001:0.text: That's Arden and Bryon, they've come to meet us at the dock.
say:0:1121226001:0.source_cn: 那是雅顿贤者和布莱恩，他们来码头接我们了。

say:1:1121227001:0.text: Master Arden was concerned after reading Lenya's letter, so he called on me to come and fetch you.
say:1:1121227001:0.source_cn: 雅顿贤者看了蕾米雅的信后放心不下，于是叫上了我来接你们。

say:2:1121227002:1.text: Indeed, she does look very similar to Laura.
say:2:1121227002:1.source_cn: 她的确和阿露拉那孩子长得一模一样。

say:3:1121227003:1.text: Laura belongs to the <style="highlight">Azure Seers</style>, I met her years ago when I was in seclusion in Vaduso.

say:4:1121227004:1.text: I've heard that clan is particularly sensitive to changes in the natural environment.
say:4:1121227004:1.source_cn: 我听说过，那一族对自然环境的变化尤为敏锐。

say:5:1121227005:1.text: Yes, their Matriarch had even foreseen that a corruption would bring disaster to the Dark Forest and the Vaduso Mountains.
say:5:1121227005:1.source_cn: 没错，他们的族长甚至早就预知到了腐化会为薄暮丛林和瓦度...

say:6:1121227006:0.text: Aves 11 predicted a storm earlier today when the sun was out! Master Arden, could it truly be Laura herself?
say:6:1121227006:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一在港口预知了暴雨将至！雅顿贤者，她果然就是阿...

say:7:1121227007:0.text: Hmm... Despite the similar appearance, I do not detect the same aura.
say:7:1121227007:0.source_cn: 是不是呢……虽然外貌很像，但是她们给我的感觉并不相同。

say:12:1121227008:0.text: Arden, it is my intention to bring Aves 11 directly to her people.
say:12:1121227008:0.source_cn: 雅顿贤者，我打算直接带阿尔法十一去找她的族人。

say:13:1121227009:1.text: Are you certain you can find them? The Azure Seers have always been an erratic clan and seldom make contact with others.
say:13:1121227009:1.source_cn: 你能顺利找到吗？告雨一族他们向来行踪不定，很少与外族联系。

say:14:1121227010:1.text: I can tell you they reside in the central region of the Vaduso Mountains. There are quite a few secluded caves in that area.
say:14:1121227010:1.source_cn: 但我可以告诉你的是，他们居住在瓦度索山脉的中部地区，那...

say:15:1121227011:0.text: Don't worry, finding people is my specialty. It's like a giant game of hide-and-seek.
say:15:1121227011:0.source_cn: 没问题，找人嘛，我擅长。我最喜欢玩躲猫猫的游戏了。

say:16:1121227012:0.text: Vaduso... It sounds so familiar, but I've never been there.
say:16:1121227012:0.source_cn: 瓦度索，很熟悉的地方……可我明明没去过。

say:17:1121227013:0.text: Laura... Could that really be my name?
say:17:1121227013:0.source_cn: 阿露拉……难道，我真的是阿露拉……

say:2:1121229002:0.text: My body hurts... I need candy.
say:2:1121229002:0.source_cn: 身体很痛……请给我一颗糖果……

say:5:1121229003:2.text: Aves 11, are you feeling pain again?
say:5:1121229003:2.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，身体是不是又开始痛了？

say:7:1121229005:0.text: Hmm... It's happening more frequently now.

say:8:1121229006:0.text: You're a strong one, aren't you? Come... Mother will give you sweets.
say:8:1121229006:0.source_cn: 好了，你是个坚强的孩子。快到妈妈身边来吧，妈妈给你糖果吃。

say:9:1121229007:0.text: Just eat the candy and everything will be alright. Here, have two this time.
say:9:1121229007:0.source_cn: 只要吃下糖果，一切都会好起来。这次要多吃两颗哦。

say:13:1121229009:0.text: The candy is bitter, but it makes the pain go away.
say:13:1121229009:0.source_cn: 虽然糖果很苦……但是只要吃下去，身体就不痛了。

say:14:1121229010:0.text: Hey, candy is sweet, right? That's not candy! You were tricked!
say:14:1121229010:0.source_cn: 喂喂喂……糖果是甜的吧？那肯定不是什么糖果！你被骗了！

say:17:1121229012:0.text: Master Arden, what's wrong with her?!
say:17:1121229012:0.source_cn: 雅顿贤者！她这是怎么了？

say:20:1121229013:0.text: These are the side effects of dark magic.

say:21:1121229014:2.text: There's no telling exactly what Illucia did to her, but her body has been tainted by dark magic for quite some time.
say:21:1121229014:2.source_cn: 不知道伊露西卡具体对她做了什么……但是可以看出，她的身...

say:22:1121229015:0.text: The candy she consumed was likely an antidote to suppress these side effects.
say:22:1121229015:0.source_cn: 她吃的糖果应该是一种魔药，能够抑制住这些副作用。

say:23:1121229016:0.text: Aves 11, I must ask, do you know how old you are?
say:23:1121229016:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，冒昧问一句，你知道自己多大吗？

say:25:1121229017:0.text: I don't know... I can't remember.
say:25:1121229017:0.source_cn: 我不知道……我不记得自己的年龄。

say:29:1121229018:0.text: Hmm... Lyca and Lenya, I want you to go to Lunadorf and find Dahnie.
say:29:1121229018:0.source_cn: 唉……莱卡、蕾米雅，你们先去一趟月湖村，去找达赫妮。

say:30:1121229019:0.text: The girl is in no condition to travel to the Vaduso Mountains.
say:30:1121229019:0.source_cn: 这孩子现在的状态，没法和你们一起去瓦度索山脉。

say:33:1121229020:0.text: Bryon, tell Elona to take my handwritten message to Dahnie. She'll know what to do.
say:33:1121229020:0.source_cn: 布莱恩，你让艾洛娜把我的手信捎给达赫妮，她知道该怎么做。

say:0:1121230001:0.text: We've arrived! Time to pay Granny Dahnie a visit.
say:0:1121230001:0.source_cn: 到了，直接去见达赫妮婆婆吧。

say:0:1121231001:0.text: Found her, she's right over there.

say:2:1121232002:0.text: Granny Dahnie! Please, save this child.
say:2:1121232002:0.source_cn: 达赫妮婆婆！请您务必救救这孩子。

say:3:1121232003:0.text: Hmph, she's in terrible shape. Lenya, take her to a bed and have her lie down.
say:3:1121232003:0.source_cn: 她的情况很糟糕……蕾米雅，你把她带去房间里，让她先躺下。

say:8:1121232005:0.text: She's clearly been affected for quite some time. She'll need a lot of care to recover.
say:8:1121232005:0.source_cn: 她受影响的时间太久了，没有什么办法能一下子治好，只能慢...

say:9:1121232006:0.text: Magister Merlin, I remember a recipe in your book for curing ailments related to dark magic's hold on the body.
say:9:1121232006:0.source_cn: 梅林，我记得你在书里写过的一个配方，能应对黑魔法对肉体...
say:9:1121232006:0.male: Magister Merlin, I remember a recipe in your book for curing ailments related to dark magic's hold on the body.
say:9:1121232006:0.female: Magister Merlin, I remember a recipe in your book for curing ailments related to dark magic's hold on the body.

choice_prompt:10:1121232006.text: Magister Merlin, I remember a recipe in your book for curing ailments related to dark magic's hold on the body.
choice_prompt:10:1121232006.source_cn: 梅林，我记得你在书里写过的一个配方，能应对黑魔法对肉体的腐蚀。
choice_prompt:10:1121232006.male: Magister Merlin, I remember a recipe in your book for curing ailments related to dark magic's hold on the body.
choice_prompt:10:1121232006.female: Magister Merlin, I remember a recipe in your book for curing ailments related to dark magic's hold on the body.

say:11:1121232007:0.text: Ah, I almost forgot that your memory is worse than mine.
say:11:1121232007:0.source_cn: 噢……差点忘了，你的记性比我还差。
say:11:1121232007:0.male: Ah, I almost forgot that your memory is worse than mine.
say:11:1121232007:0.female: Ah, I almost forgot that your memory is worse than mine.

say:12:1121232008:0.text: You wrote this book decades ago on potions. I've kept it in my collection.
say:12:1121232008:0.source_cn: 那是你几十年前写的一本魔药学著作，我一直收藏着呢。
say:12:1121232008:0.male: You wrote this book decades ago on potions. I've kept it in my collection.
say:12:1121232008:0.female: You wrote this book decades ago on potions. I've kept it in my collection.

say:13:1121232010:0.text: The recipe requires several herbs, and luckily they're all native to this area.
say:13:1121232010:0.source_cn: 这个配方需要几种药草，幸运的是，这附近应该能找齐。

say:14:1121232011:0.text: Lenya and I will make preparations. Lyca, go with the Magister and collect the herbs.
say:14:1121232011:0.source_cn: 我和蕾米雅来做熬制的准备。莱卡，你陪梅林去采药草吧。
say:14:1121232011:0.male: Lenya and I will make preparations. Lyca, go with the Magister and collect the herbs.
say:14:1121232011:0.female: Lenya and I will make preparations. Lyca, go with the Magister and collect the herbs.

say:15:1121232012:0.text: Move quickly, time is of the essence.
say:15:1121232012:0.source_cn: 时间紧急，你们动作要快。
say:15:1121232012:0.male: Move quickly, time is of the essence.
say:15:1121232012:0.female: Move quickly, time is of the essence.

say:17:1121232009:0.text: A book on potions. You wrote it decades ago and have clearly forgotten all about it.
say:17:1121232009:0.source_cn: 魔药学的书，你几十年前写的。看你的表情一定是又忘了。
say:17:1121232009:0.male: A book on potions. You wrote it decades ago and have clearly forgotten all about it.
say:17:1121232009:0.female: A book on potions. You wrote it decades ago and have clearly forgotten all about it.

say:0:1121233001:0.text: Hopefully Aves 11 can get well soon.
say:0:1121233001:0.source_cn: 但愿阿尔法十一能早日康复。

say:0:1121234001:0.text: I'm not sure how long she can hold on. We must hurry.
say:0:1121234001:0.source_cn: 不知道阿尔法十一能坚持多久，我们得快点。

say:0:1121235001:0.text: I always wind up bothering you with some great task... Thank you!
say:0:1121235001:0.source_cn: 每次都要麻烦您做这种事，谢谢您的帮助！
say:0:1121235001:0.male: I always wind up bothering you with some great task... Thank you!
say:0:1121235001:0.female: I always wind up bothering you with some great task... Thank you!

say:1:1121236001:0.text: The girl ran away! She was injured, yet she moved faster than anyone I've ever seen!
say:1:1121236001:0.source_cn: 那姑娘跑了！气死我了……伤成那样，跑得比谁都快！

say:3:1121236002:0.text: Ran away? Why would she... Does she still not believe us?
say:3:1121236002:0.source_cn: 跑了？怎么会……她还是不愿意相信我们吗？

say:4:1121236003:1.text: Lyca, it will not be easy to win her trust.
say:4:1121236003:1.source_cn: 莱卡，想赢得她的信任，没那么容易。

say:5:1121236004:0.text: She's been indoctrinated by the Adamant Syndicate for quite some time. We must be patient.
say:5:1121236004:0.source_cn: 她被黑金商会养了那么久，我们需要多给她一点耐心。

say:7:1121236005:0.text: Granny Dahnie! She was seen heading toward the Bizarre Labyrinth!
say:7:1121236005:0.source_cn: 达赫妮婆婆！有人看见她往诡幻迷宫的方向去了！

say:8:1121236006:0.text: Hurry and bring her back! Leave the herbs, and as soon as she returns, make sure she drinks the potion.
say:8:1121236006:0.source_cn: 快去把她追回来！药草留下，等她回来了立马给我喝干净！

say:0:1121237001:0.text: The Bizarre Labyrinth is real complicated. Let's tread carefully.
say:0:1121237001:0.source_cn: 诡幻迷宫错综复杂，我们得仔细些。

say:1:1121238001:0.text: Oh, you picked up a feather? Show me!
say:1:1121238001:0.source_cn: 你捡到了一根羽毛？我看看。
say:1:1121238001:0.male: Oh, you picked up a feather? Show me!
say:1:1121238001:0.female: Oh, you picked up a feather? Show me!

choice_prompt:2:1121238001.text: Oh, you picked up a feather? Show me!
choice_prompt:2:1121238001.source_cn: 你捡到了一根羽毛？我看看。
choice_prompt:2:1121238001.male: Oh, you picked up a feather? Show me!
choice_prompt:2:1121238001.female: Oh, you picked up a feather? Show me!

say:3:1121238002:2.text: A freshly fallen feather... Light, soft, not covered in dirt or dust.
say:3:1121238002:2.source_cn: 这是刚刚掉落的羽毛，轻盈，柔软，还没有粘上灰尘。

say:5:1121238003:0.text: Looks like she passed through here recently. Let's keep looking.
say:5:1121238003:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一应该刚离开不久，我们沿着这条路继续寻找吧。

say:0:1121239001:0.text: She's likely headed west. Let's hop in the portal and see.
say:0:1121239001:0.source_cn: 她可能去了西边，进传送门吧，我们过去看看。

say:0:1121240001:0.text: Do you know where the exit is?

say:1:1121241001:0.text: Kiddo, why did you just run away like that?
say:1:1121241001:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一！你为什么逃走？

say:2:1121241002:0.text: Too many people were asking me questions. It made me feel nervous.
say:2:1121241002:0.source_cn: 那里提问的人太多了，我很不自在。

say:3:1121241003:0.text: But in order to treat you, we gotta ask questions, right? We're trying to help you, not torture you!
say:3:1121241003:0.source_cn: 真是的……要给你治病，总得问清楚病状吧？大家是在关心你...

say:4:1121241004:0.text: It's too risky to stick around here. Come back with us.
say:4:1121241004:0.source_cn: 这片山谷很危险，赶紧跟我们回去了。

say:5:1121241005:0.text: Wait. I want to know what these flowers are... I've seen them in my dreams.
say:5:1121241005:0.source_cn: 等等，我想知道这片蓝色的花朵是什么？它们在我的梦中出现过。

say:7:1121241007:0.text: In two more seasons, they'll grow into creatures called glimmerblooms.
say:7:1121241007:0.source_cn: 大约再过两个落叶季，它们会长成名为荧荧花的生物。

choice_prompt:8:1121241007.text: In two more seasons, they'll grow into creatures called glimmerblooms.
choice_prompt:8:1121241007.source_cn: 大约再过两个落叶季，它们会长成名为荧荧花的生物。

say:9:1121241008:0.text: Yup! Is this the first you've heard of this? Seems like the Dark Forest has a lot more for you to explore, Magister.
say:9:1121241008:0.source_cn: 是哦，你第一次听说吗？看来薄暮丛林仍有很多事值得你去探...
say:9:1121241008:0.male: Yup! Is this the first you've heard of this? Seems like the Dark Forest has a lot more for you to explore, Magister.
say:9:1121241008:0.female: Yup! Is this the first you've heard of this? Seems like the Dark Forest has a lot more for you to explore, Magister.

say:10:1121241009:0.text: When the glimmerblooms die, their bodies return to the earth and become manafleurs once more. Ya know, the cycle of life.
say:10:1121241009:0.source_cn: 荧荧花死亡后，身体也将回归大地，再次生出魔花。这便是生...

say:11:1121241010:0.text: I don't think I understand. What does it mean to return to earth? What is the cycle of life?
say:11:1121241010:0.source_cn: 我好像没听懂。\n回归大地是什么？生命的循环又是什么？

say:12:1121241011:0.text: No need to worry about it now. You're tired and need to rest. Come with us.
say:12:1121241011:0.source_cn: 那就不要理解了，你现在身体不好嘛，脑子也会跟不上的，先...

say:14:1121241013:0.text: Stubborn kid... We don't have time now, but as soon as I get a chance, I promise to explain it all.
say:14:1121241013:0.source_cn: 真是任性……\n没办法，有机会的话，我再慢慢讲给你听吧。

say:15:1121241014:0.text: My word is my bond, and I'd never break a promise!
say:15:1121241014:0.source_cn: 放心，我可是个很守信用的人。既然答应你了，我一定会做到。

say:0:1121242001:0.text: Is that Damian? What's that kid tinkering with now?
say:0:1121242001:0.source_cn: 那是达米安？他是不是又在搞什么小发明？

say:1:1121243001:0.text: Damian, what's up with that nest of birds?
say:1:1121243001:0.source_cn: 达米安，你面前的这窝小鸟怎么了？

say:2:1121243002:0.text: I picked them up this afternoon on the north side of Lunadorf. They appeared to have been blown out of a tree by a strong wind and had injured their wings.
say:2:1121243002:0.source_cn: 今天下午，我在月湖村北边捡到了它们。它们似乎被强风从树...

say:3:1121243003:0.text: I made tiny braces to help them heal.
say:3:1121243003:0.source_cn: 我为它们制作了固定装置，想帮它们修复骨折的翅膀。

say:4:1121243004:0.text: But Uncle Dyan says that they were also suffering from internal injuries...
say:4:1121243004:0.source_cn: 但是迪恩叔叔和我说，它们不止翅膀骨折了，体内也有骨刺，...

say:5:1121243005:0.text: Uncle Dyan gave me some herbs that would ease their pain. I just wanted to let them pass on as painlessly as I could.
say:5:1121243005:0.source_cn: 迪恩叔叔给了我一些草药，这些草药点燃后的香气可以缓解痛...

say:7:1121243006:0.text: The little birds... are they dead?

say:8:1121243007:0.text: Yes... they stopped moving just before you got here.
say:8:1121243007:0.source_cn: 是的……你们来之前，它们的身体已经不再动弹了。

say:9:1121243008:0.text: Why do you look so sad? Soon they will open their eyes again.
say:9:1121243008:0.source_cn: 为什么你看起来很悲伤呢？它们很快就会睁开眼睛。

say:10:1121243009:0.text: Don't treat me like a child! Don't lie to me.
say:10:1121243009:0.source_cn: 别拿我当小孩子！我可不会相信这种谎言。

say:11:1121243010:0.text: I'm not lying. Mother says that death is like a deep sleep, and after a while you'll wake up again.
say:11:1121243010:0.source_cn: 我没有撒谎。\n妈妈说过，死亡是沉睡，过一段时间就会醒来。

say:12:1121243011:2.text: The dead don't wake up, your mother's lying to you!
say:12:1121243011:2.source_cn: 死亡的生命可不会醒来，你的妈妈在骗你！

say:13:1121243012:0.text: Leave me alone... I just want to bury these little birds.
say:13:1121243012:0.source_cn: 我不想听你胡说了，我要埋葬这些死掉的小鸟。

say:14:1121243013:0.text: You're going to bury them in the dirt? No, they won't be able to breathe when they wake up!
say:14:1121243013:0.source_cn: 你要把它们埋进土里？不可以，它们醒来时会被压得喘不过气。

say:15:1121243014:0.text: Uhh... I'm not sure exactly what you learned about death, but these little birds aren't waking up again, kiddo.
say:15:1121243014:0.source_cn: 呃……我不知道一直以来你是怎么理解死亡的，但是这些小鸟...

say:16:1121243015:0.text: I'll prove it to you. I'm not going anywhere until they open their eyes.
say:16:1121243015:0.source_cn: 我会证明给你们看的，我哪也不去，我要守在这里。

say:17:1121243016:0.text: You're weird! They're gone, and they should be allowed to return to nature.
say:17:1121243016:0.source_cn: 你真奇怪！它们已经走了，应该让它们回归自然！

say:19:1121243017:0.text: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?
say:19:1121243017:0.male: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?
say:19:1121243017:0.female: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?

choice_prompt:20:1121243017.text: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?
choice_prompt:20:1121243017.source_cn: 唉……怎么会变成这样？<style=stress><player_name></style>，我该怎么办？
choice_prompt:20:1121243017.male: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?
choice_prompt:20:1121243017.female: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?

say:21:1121243018:0.text: Hmm... If it keeps her from running away, I guess she can stay for a while.
say:21:1121243018:0.source_cn: 嗯……她要是不再逃跑的话，待在这里也不是不行。

say:22:1121243020:0.text: I'll go get the medicine and then Damian will take you somewhere to rest. You must be tired.
say:22:1121243020:0.source_cn: 那么我去拿药，让达米安带你去休息吧，你跟我们奔波一天，...
say:22:1121243020:0.male: I'll go get the medicine and then Damian will take you somewhere to rest. You must be tired.
say:22:1121243020:0.female: I'll go get the medicine and then Damian will take you somewhere to rest. You must be tired.

say:23:1121243021:0.source_cn: 我们等到天亮了再做打算。

say:25:1121243019:0.text: Well, I suppose I'll fetch the medicine and bring it here. If this keeps her from running away again, so be it.
say:25:1121243019:0.source_cn: 总之我先把药拿来，让她喝下。至于她想待在哪里，只要她不...

narration:0:1121243101:0.text: You're so occupied with the issue of Aves 11 that you don't get a wink of sleep the whole night... and now, it's almost sunrise.
narration:0:1121243101:0.source_cn: 由于想着阿尔法十一的事情，晚上并没有睡好……天已经快亮了

say:0:1121244001:0.text: Aves 11 has been watching over the birds all night. Let's go check on her.
say:0:1121244001:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一似乎在小鸟前守了一整晚，去看看吧。
say:0:1121244001:0.male: Aves 11 has been watching over the birds all night. Let's go check on her.
say:0:1121244001:0.female: Aves 11 has been watching over the birds all night. Let's go check on her.

say:1:1121247001:1.text: I was waiting for them to open their eyes... I thought they'd wake up by morning.
say:1:1121247001:1.source_cn: 我一直在等它们睁开眼睛，我想等到天亮的时候，它们就会醒...

say:2:1121247002:0.text: But the sun has been rising steadily.
say:2:1121247002:0.source_cn: 可是，今天的太阳，升起得好慢啊。

say:3:1121247003:0.text: I noticed that their smell changed... they smell almost fishy. I tried to call out to them, but nothing worked.
say:3:1121247003:0.source_cn: 我发现，它们的味道也变了，变得腥臭。我试着呼唤过它们，...

choice_prompt:4:1121247003.text: I noticed that their smell changed... they smell almost fishy. I tried to call out to them, but nothing worked.
choice_prompt:4:1121247003.source_cn: 我发现，它们的味道也变了，变得腥臭。我试着呼唤过它们，没有用。

narration:5:1121247004:0.text: The birds' bodies, yet to be buried, have started to rot due to the weather...
narration:5:1121247004:0.source_cn: 由于没有及时埋葬，受天气影响，小鸟的尸体已经有些腐坏了……

say:6:1121247005:0.text: So Lenya and that little boy were telling the truth. Mother lied to me.
say:6:1121247005:0.source_cn: 蕾米雅和那个小男孩没有骗我，是妈妈骗了我。

say:8:1121247006:0.text: Mother, what's wrong with those people? Why aren't they moving? I heard someone say they're dead.
say:8:1121247006:0.source_cn: 妈妈，那些人怎么了？为什么一动不动？我听到有人说，他们死了。

say:11:1121247009:1.text: When they finish their beautiful dreams.

say:12:1121247010:0.text: Death is silent, cold, smelly, and can look so bad.
say:12:1121247010:0.source_cn: 死亡，会沉默、会冰冷、会腥臭，会变成各种糟糕的模样。

say:14:1121247012:0.text: The old me has done awful, awful things!
say:14:1121247012:0.source_cn: 以前的我，做了很坏很坏的事！

choice_prompt:15:1121247012.text: The old me has done awful, awful things!
choice_prompt:15:1121247012.source_cn: 以前的我，做了很坏很坏的事！

say:16:1121247013:0.text: I don't deserve comfort, but thank you... You're a kind person.
say:16:1121247013:0.source_cn: 我不值得受到安慰……但是，谢谢你，你是一个温柔的人。
say:16:1121247013:0.male: I don't deserve comfort, but thank you... You're a kind person.
say:16:1121247013:0.female: I don't deserve comfort, but thank you... You're a kind person.

say:17:1121247015:0.text: What should I do with these little birds? They shouldn't be left here.
say:17:1121247015:0.source_cn: 这些小鸟，我应该怎么办？我不希望它们被放在这里。

choice_prompt:18:1121247015.text: What should I do with these little birds? They shouldn't be left here.
choice_prompt:18:1121247015.source_cn: 这些小鸟，我应该怎么办？我不希望它们被放在这里。

say:19:1121247016:0.text: I've heard this forest has its own goddess, and people worship it at an altar in the village.
say:19:1121247016:0.source_cn: 听说，这片丛林有自己信奉的神明，村子里就有那位神明的小...

say:20:1121247017:0.text: I'd like to bury the birds near it. Can you show me the way? Please.
say:20:1121247017:0.source_cn: 我想把小鸟埋葬在那附近。你能为我带路吗？拜托了。
say:20:1121247017:0.male: I'd like to bury the birds near it. Can you show me the way? Please.
say:20:1121247017:0.female: I'd like to bury the birds near it. Can you show me the way? Please.

say:22:1121247014:0.text: I want to try and make up for my past... even if much of it can't be undone.
say:22:1121247014:0.source_cn: 我希望能够弥补自己的过错，尽管……或许根本无法弥补。

choice:15:1:2.text: You know what you should do now.
choice:15:1:2.male: You know what you should do now.
choice:15:1:2.female: You know what you should do now.

say:1:1121249001:0.text: So you're here... I was afraid Aves 11 had run away again!
say:1:1121249001:0.source_cn: 吓我一跳……原来你们跑来这里了，我还以为阿尔法十一又逃...

choice_prompt:2:1121249001.text: So you're here... I was afraid Aves 11 had run away again!
choice_prompt:2:1121249001.source_cn: 吓我一跳……原来你们跑来这里了，我还以为阿尔法十一又逃走了呢！

say:3:1121249002:0.text: Well, Damian is still upset. I'll tell him later that the birds have been buried.
say:3:1121249002:0.source_cn: 好吧……达米安还在生气呢，我之后会告诉他，小鸟已经被安葬了。

say:4:1121249003:0.text: If they're buried in the soil, will they grow out of the earth again like the manafleurs?
say:4:1121249003:0.source_cn: 只要把它们埋进土里，它们也能像魔花一样，再从土里生长出来吗？

say:6:1121249005:0.text: Then what is the point of doing this?

say:7:1121249006:0.text: Life comes from nature. When we die, we should return to it.
say:7:1121249006:0.source_cn: 我们的生命源于自然，死后，也应当回归自然。

say:8:1121249007:0.text: But when the living know the dead have a place they've returned to, it gives comfort.
say:8:1121249007:0.source_cn: 但是死者有了归处，其实是生者获得慰藉。或许这就是意义吧。

say:10:1121249009:0.text: I promise you'll get it when you know more of who you are. Let's not think about it now. Granny Dahnie wants to see you.
say:10:1121249009:0.source_cn: 等你知道自己的身份后，一定可以理解。现在先别想这些了，...

say:11:1121249010:0.text: She wants to know how you're doing after taking the medicine. Let's go see her.
say:11:1121249010:0.source_cn: 她想知道你吃了药以后情况如何，快过去找她吧。

say:0:1121250001:0.text: Better not keep Granny Dahnie waiting!
say:0:1121250001:0.source_cn: 达赫妮婆婆在等我们，走吧。

say:1:1121252001:0.text: Aves 11, you're looking much better. How are you feeling?
say:1:1121252001:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，我看你的脸色好了不少。你自己感觉还行吗？

say:2:1121252002:0.text: After drinking your candy, my body doesn't hurt anymore. I never knew that candy could be like water.
say:2:1121252002:0.source_cn: 喝了你们的糖果后，身体已经不痛了。我第一次知道，还有水...

say:3:1121252003:0.text: That was a herbal soup, not candy. When you're all better, I'll show you what real candy tastes like.
say:3:1121252003:0.source_cn: 那叫药汤，不是糖果。\n等你病好以后，再去尝尝真正的糖...

say:4:1121252004:0.text: Now, you must remember this for me. Take these pills three times a day before meals. And you mustn't skip any meals!
say:4:1121252004:0.source_cn: 现在你可给我记住了，这些药，一天三次，饭前服用，一顿都...

say:6:1121252006:0.text: What's this, now? Times like this, it's proper to say thank you.
say:6:1121252006:0.source_cn: 哦什么哦？这种时候要说谢谢。

say:8:1121252008:0.text: Not to me, but to Lenya and the others. If they hadn't brought you back in time, you might not be with us any more.
say:8:1121252008:0.source_cn: 不是对我说，而是对蕾米雅他们。要不是他们及时带你回来，...

say:18:1121252011:0.text: Aves 11, if you've regained your strength, it's time for us to head to the Vaduso Mountains.
say:18:1121252011:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，要是你的体力已经恢复，我们也该去瓦度索山脉了。

say:19:1121252012:0.text: Hm, the answers I'm after seem to be hidden there.
say:19:1121252012:0.source_cn: 嗯，我想要的答案，似乎都藏在那里。

say:1:1121253001:0.text: According to Arden, the Azure Seers clan lives around here.
say:1:1121253001:0.source_cn: 根据雅顿贤者的情报，告雨一族就住在这片区域。

say:2:1121253002:0.text: Hey kiddo, remember anything about this place?
say:2:1121253002:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，你对这附近还有什么印象吗？

say:3:1121253003:0.text: I only have a very faint feeling.
say:3:1121253003:0.source_cn: 我只有某种很微弱的感觉，还不能确定。

say:4:1121253004:0.source_cn: 那我们先在附近转转吧。

say:0:1121255001:0.text: I don't feel anything over here.

say:1:1121258001:0.text: I'm all turned around... Which way do we go?
say:1:1121258001:0.source_cn: 哎呀……真是昏了头了，到底该往哪边走啊？

say:2:1121258002:0.text: There's one path that seems to be drawing me closer.
say:2:1121258002:0.source_cn: 有一条路，让我很在意。我觉得那条路的前方，似乎隐藏着什么。

say:3:1121258003:0.source_cn: 既然你有特殊的感知能力，我们应该相信你的直觉。

say:4:1121258004:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，你认为哪条路才是正确的？

say:0:1121259001:0.text: Found the entrance! But there seems to be some sort of mechanism here.
say:0:1121259001:0.source_cn: 发现入口了！但那里好像有一个机关。

say:0:1121260001:0.text: Wow, it worked! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're amazing! Let's take a closer look.
say:0:1121260001:0.male: Wow, it worked! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're amazing! Let's take a closer look.
say:0:1121260001:0.female: Wow, it worked! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're amazing! Let's take a closer look.

say:0:1121260101:0.text: What a deep cave. Is this where the Azure Seers live?
say:0:1121260101:0.source_cn: 好深的洞穴，告雨一族就住在这里吗？

say:1:1121261001:0.text: Based on this... Kiddo, Laura isn't your name.
say:1:1121261001:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，阿露拉好像并不是你的名字。

say:2:1121261002:0.text: Rather, it's your mother's name... your real mother.
say:2:1121261002:0.source_cn: 而是你母亲的名字——我是说，真正的母亲。

say:4:1121261004:0.text: I want to see her! Can I?
say:4:1121261004:0.source_cn: 我想见到她，我能见到她吗？

say:5:1121261005:0.text: I don't know, but let's keep looking! We won't give up.
say:5:1121261005:0.source_cn: 我也不知道……再找找看吧！别放弃。

say:0:1121262001:0.text: Look, the exit is that way.

say:1:1121263001:0.text: Look! Why do I feel like something is missing from this?
say:1:1121263001:0.source_cn: 你们快看！我怎么觉得这个上面缺了一块东西？

say:2:1121263002:0.text: Indeed, it's like a piece was prised away.
say:2:1121263002:0.source_cn: 的确，像是被撬走了一块。

say:3:1121263003:0.text: That said, the shape of the defect seems familiar.
say:3:1121263003:0.source_cn: 话说这个缺损的形状……好像有些眼熟啊。

say:5:1121263005:0.text: Hey, take out that little thingy you've been carrying around!
say:5:1121263005:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，快把你身上那个东西拿出来。

say:7:1121263007:0.text: That's right, try placing it in that spot.
say:7:1121263007:0.source_cn: 没错，我们把石雕放上去试试。

say:1:1121263101:0.text: I never expected it to be the key to a door.
say:1:1121263101:0.source_cn: 没想到这块石雕竟然是开门的钥匙。

say:2:1121263102:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate stole the key to keep others from returning here and learning of what they've done.
say:2:1121263102:0.source_cn: 黑金商会为了不让别人进入这里，偷走了这块石雕，他们不希...

say:3:1121263103:0.text: But... Aves 11, I'm not sure you'll be able to find your people.
say:3:1121263103:0.source_cn: 但是……阿尔法十一，我不确定你能不能找到自己的族人。

say:4:1121263104:0.text: It seems they've left the Vaduso Mountains.
say:4:1121263104:0.source_cn: 因为他们好像……离开瓦度索山脉了。

say:6:1121263106:0.text: But after coming all this way, I wish to forge on ahead.
say:6:1121263106:0.source_cn: 可是，已经走到了这里，我还想再往前一步。

say:7:1121263107:0.text: Even if the answers I obtain are full of sadness, I don't want to run from them.
say:7:1121263107:0.source_cn: 就算是一个悲伤的答案在等待我，我也不想逃避。

say:8:1121263108:0.text: We've got your back, and together we can handle anything!
say:8:1121263108:0.source_cn: 有我们陪着你呢，没什么迈不过去的坎。我们一起面对吧。

say:0:1121264001:0.text: Everything is ragged and tattered... No one's been here in a long time.
say:0:1121264001:0.source_cn: 破破烂烂的，这里的人已经离开很久了……

say:1:1121265001:0.text: There's not a soul in sight.

say:2:1121265002:0.text: They foresaw the corruption long ago and migrated elsewhere.
say:2:1121265002:0.source_cn: 他们早早预见到了腐化发生，在那之前迁徙去了别处。

say:3:1121265003:0.text: Aves 11, don't feel sad. Now that the corruption has been addressed at the source, maybe they'll return.
say:3:1121265003:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，你别难过……如今腐化已经从源头解决了，或许...

say:4:1121265004:0.text: Maybe I can wait here until they come back?
say:4:1121265004:0.source_cn: 如果我在这里等待……能等到他们回来吗？

say:5:1121265005:0.text: How long will I have to wait?

say:6:1121265006:0.text: It's... hard to say. And I don't want to lie to you or give you false hope.
say:6:1121265006:0.source_cn: 这个……不好说啊。我也不想撒谎骗你。

say:7:1121265007:0.text: ... It's alright, I understand this time.

say:8:1121265008:0.text: Can I be alone for a while? I'd like to sit in the quiet.
say:8:1121265008:0.source_cn: 我可以独自待一会儿吗？我想稍微静一静。

say:0:1121266001:0.text: Aren't there any other leads? I'll dig around!
say:0:1121266001:0.source_cn: 难道就没有其他线索了？我再去找找看！

say:0:1121267001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Aves 11! Come quickly, I found a letter!
say:0:1121267001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Aves 11! Come quickly, I found a letter!
say:0:1121267001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Aves 11! Come quickly, I found a letter!

say:2:1121268002:0.text: It was in a broken crate! It's a letter from Laura, to you!
say:2:1121268002:0.source_cn: 我在一个破箱子里找到的！\n这是阿露拉的亲笔信哦——留...

say:3:1121268003:0.source_cn: 你的名字才不是什么阿尔法十一。

say:5:1121268005:0.text: Lily May... I do appreciate the smell of lilies, and the month of May... It's such a warm time of the year.
say:5:1121268005:0.source_cn: 五月……我喜欢五月。\n那是，很温暖的时节。

say:7:1121268007:0.text: My name... is Lily May. This is one of the answers I've been searching for.
say:7:1121268007:0.source_cn: 我的名字，五月。这是我找到的答案。

say:8:1121268008:0.text: Not only that, but the letter also mentions that they went east of the Vaduso Mountains, and your mother even left a map of their route.
say:8:1121268008:0.source_cn: 不止如此，信中也提到他们去了瓦度索山脉以东的地方，你的...

say:9:1121268009:0.text: Lily May, you can go look for her!
say:9:1121268009:0.source_cn: 五月，你可以去寻找他们！

say:10:1121268010:0.text: I'll actually be able to see her...
say:10:1121268010:0.source_cn: 也就是说，我真的能见到他们了。

say:11:1121268011:0.text: If you follow the directions marked on the map, I'm sure you'll find the clan.
say:11:1121268011:0.source_cn: 是的，只要你按地图标注的方位寻找，一定可以找到族人们。

say:12:1121268012:0.text: But I can't go... I must return to that general in Holistone.
say:12:1121268012:0.source_cn: 可是我不能走……我得回到圣石镇，回到那位将军面前。

say:15:1121268013:0.text: Aves 11... Has Mother done something wrong? You tell me I've done nothing wrong! Say it!
say:15:1121268013:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一……是妈妈做错了吗？你告诉妈妈，妈妈没有错，...

say:17:1121268015:0.text: It's not me who's wrong! NOT ME! I was ready to sacrifice everything!
say:17:1121268015:0.source_cn: 对……错的不是我！\n——不是我！我明明愿意付出一切！

say:19:1121268016:0.text: Illucia, you've had too much! Put down the glass!
say:19:1121268016:0.source_cn: 伊露西卡女士，您喝醉了！快把酒杯放下吧！

say:20:1121268017:0.text: SHUT UP! I'm not the one who has to pay for their sins! NOT ME!
say:20:1121268017:0.source_cn: 滚开！你们听着……我没有错，要偿还罪孽的人，也不是我！

say:21:1121268018:1.text: Mother... Calm down! I'll take the blame for you!
say:21:1121268018:1.source_cn: 妈妈……您冷静点！我愿意替您承担！

say:22:1121268019:0.text: I... can't run away from it.

say:23:1121268020:0.text: I'm still carrying sins I can't wash away.
say:23:1121268020:0.source_cn: 因为我还背负着无法洗清的罪孽。

choice_prompt:24:1121268020.text: I'm still carrying sins I can't wash away.
choice_prompt:24:1121268020.source_cn: 因为我还背负着无法洗清的罪孽。

say:26:1121268022:0.text: You made me realize that I cannot escape my past.
say:26:1121268022:0.source_cn: 因为你让我意识到，我曾经做了多么过分的事情。我不能逃避惩罚。

say:28:1121268024:0.text: Lily May, I'm so happy to see your growth.
say:28:1121268024:0.source_cn: 五月，看到你的成长，我很高兴。

say:29:1121268025:0.text: Lenya, this time you'll escort them to Holistone.
say:29:1121268025:0.source_cn: 那么，蕾米雅，这次就由你护送他们去圣石镇。

say:32:1121268027:0.text: I'm going to update Granny Dahnie and Arden. You're already in charge, so surely you can handle this?
say:32:1121268027:0.source_cn: 我要向达赫妮婆婆和雅顿贤者说明情况。你已经独当一面了，...

say:33:1121268028:0.text: Fine by me, I'm just looking forward to the grub at the Traveler's Light!
say:33:1121268028:0.source_cn: 我是无所谓啦，反正我很喜欢吃旅人灯火的饭！

say:34:1121268029:0.text: ... Try to focus on more than just food.

say:35:1121268030:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please pass on some much needed guidance to Lenya.
say:35:1121268030:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please pass on some much needed guidance to Lenya.
say:35:1121268030:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please pass on some much needed guidance to Lenya.

choice_prompt:36:1121268030.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please pass on some much needed guidance to Lenya.
choice_prompt:36:1121268030.source_cn: 唉，<style=stress><player_name></style>，还要麻烦你多多教导蕾米雅了。
choice_prompt:36:1121268030.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please pass on some much needed guidance to Lenya.
choice_prompt:36:1121268030.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please pass on some much needed guidance to Lenya.

say:37:1121268031:0.text: Ohh, private guidance from Magister Merlin himself? How'd I get so lucky?
say:37:1121268031:0.source_cn: 又能得到梅林大人的私家指导了？我真是幸运。
say:37:1121268031:0.male: Ohh, private guidance from Magister Merlin himself? How'd I get so lucky?
say:37:1121268031:0.female: Ohh, private guidance from Magister Merlin herself? How'd I get so lucky?

say:38:1121268033:0.text: Alright, then. I wish you all a safe journey.
say:38:1121268033:0.source_cn: 好了好了，那么，我祝各位一路顺风。

say:39:1121268034:0.text: Especially you, Lily May. Misarte's blessings upon you.
say:39:1121268034:0.source_cn: 尤其是你，五月。愿弥萨忒庇佑你。

say:44:1121268032:0.text: Am I really giving you that much of a headache already? How sad...
say:44:1121268032:0.source_cn: 哎？我这么让你头疼吗？人家好伤心……
say:44:1121268032:0.male: Am I really giving you that much of a headache already? How sad...
say:44:1121268032:0.female: Am I really giving you that much of a headache already? How sad...

choice:36:1:2.text: I guess I'll do my best...
choice:36:1:2.male: I guess I'll do my best...
choice:36:1:2.female: I guess I'll do my best...

say:3:1121269002:0.text: Is that so... Lily May is a fine, warm name. I'm glad to meet you anew.
say:3:1121269002:0.source_cn: 是吗……五月，是个温暖的名字。很高兴以这样的方式重新认识你。

say:5:1121269003:0.text: I didn't want to run from my guilt, so I came back to accept whatever punishment I deserve.
say:5:1121269003:0.source_cn: 我不想逃避罪责，于是回来了。无论什么样的惩罚，我都接受。

say:7:1121269005:1.text: Alright, Lily May, please leave with my soldiers to await judgement.
say:7:1121269005:1.source_cn: 那么五月，请你随我的士兵离开，等候审判吧。

narration:10:1121269007:0.text: The soldiers take Lily May away. Before leaving, she gazes deeply at us, as if trying to express her gratitude.
narration:10:1121269007:0.source_cn: 士兵将五月带走了，临走前，她深深地望向了我们，似乎又说...

say:12:1121269008:0.text: There are some things I've been afraid to say in front of Lily May.
say:12:1121269008:0.source_cn: 有些事情，当着五月的面，我一直不敢说。

choice_prompt:13:1121269008.text: There are some things I've been afraid to say in front of Lily May.
choice_prompt:13:1121269008.source_cn: 有些事情，当着五月的面，我一直不敢说。

say:14:1121269009:0.text: Based on Lily May's ailments, Arden worked out what kind of evil magic Illucia used on her.
say:14:1121269009:0.source_cn: 根据五月的病症，雅顿贤者已经推测出黑金女士在她身上用了...

say:15:1121269010:0.text: A lot of it made my head spin, but it seems like dark magic that speeds up the flow of time was used on her body.
say:15:1121269010:0.source_cn: 我不懂魔法，听得云里雾里，那好像是一种能让身体的时间流...

say:16:1121269011:0.text: In some places, catalysts like this are used on crops to make them grow faster.
say:16:1121269011:0.source_cn: 有些地方培育作物时会加入催化剂，让作物的生长速度变快。

say:17:1121269012:0.text: I bet this is why she was called Aves 11.
say:17:1121269012:0.source_cn: 我猜，她被叫做阿尔法十一也是这个原因。

say:18:1121269013:0.text: Before her, Illucia was probably experimenting on many others. Aves 10, Aves 9, so on...
say:18:1121269013:0.source_cn: 在她之前，黑金女士也进行过类似的实验。只是阿尔法十和阿...

say:19:1121269014:0.text: We will investigate further and expose this evil for what it is!
say:19:1121269014:0.source_cn: 我们一定会严查此事，早日揭开他们的黑幕！

say:20:1121269015:0.text: I'll be paying close attention to the Adamant Syndicate's movements, I'll write to you if I learn of anything. Feel free to do the same.
say:20:1121269015:0.source_cn: 我也会多留意黑金商会的动向，要是有什么线索，我会写信告...

say:21:1121269016:0.text: It's an honor to have met you, Lenya.
say:21:1121269016:0.source_cn: 当然，能与你相识，我很荣幸。蕾米雅小姐。

say:22:1121269017:0.text: Oh, don't be so formal, old man. I'll take my leave now. My mouth is watering thinking about the food at the Traveler's Light...
say:22:1121269017:0.source_cn: 少说客套话。那我先走一步，我还惦记着旅人灯火的饭菜呢。

say:26:1121269019:0.text: Alright, I'll look after Lily May. She doesn't deserve harsh punishment.
say:26:1121269019:0.source_cn: 好的。五月的事情我会好好处理。她不该受到过重的处罚。

say:27:1121269022:0.text: But the news that the Adamant Syndicate had performed such a cruel and forbidden experiment... it boils my blood.
say:27:1121269022:0.source_cn: 但是，黑金商会竟然做过如此残忍的禁忌实验……这个消息令...

say:28:1121269023:0.text: A bunch of fanatical Hypogean worshippers. I can only imagine what else they have in store.
say:28:1121269023:0.source_cn: 一群狂热的恶魔信徒……我无法想象他们还会做出怎样的恶行。

say:29:1121269024:0.text: Even though we're onto their wicked ways, we must not let our guard drop for a second. The Adamant Syndicate will continue to scheme in the dark.
say:29:1121269024:0.source_cn: 即使被我们打压了气焰，可我相信，黑金商会依然在暗中密谋...

say:30:1121269025:0.text: But as for now, let us enjoy a rare moment of peace.
say:30:1121269025:0.source_cn: 至于现在，就让你我享受片刻的安宁吧。
say:30:1121269025:0.male: But as for now, let us enjoy a rare moment of peace.
say:30:1121269025:0.female: But as for now, let us enjoy a rare moment of peace.

say:32:1121269020:0.text: I swear she will be judged fairly.
say:32:1121269020:0.source_cn: 我一定会让她得到公正的判决。

say:33:1121269021:0.text: She cannot be fully blamed after enduring the controlling bite of dark magic. Fear not.
say:33:1121269021:0.source_cn: 再加上她受过黑魔法控制，我想，处罚不会太重。你放心。
say:33:1121269021:0.male: She cannot be fully blamed after enduring the controlling bite of dark magic. Fear not.
say:33:1121269021:0.female: She cannot be fully blamed after enduring the controlling bite of dark magic. Fear not.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1121214001:.text: Let me get a good look at you!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1121214001:.source_cn: 抬头！让我看看你的长相！
cinematic_dialogue:2:1121214001:.male: Let me get a good look at you!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1121214001:.female: Let me get a good look at you!

say:4:1121215001:0.text: It's you! You can't fool me that easily!
say:4:1121215001:0.source_cn: 果然是你！看你鬼鬼祟祟的样子，我早发觉不对劲了！
say:4:1121215001:0.male: It's you! You can't fool me that easily!
say:4:1121215001:0.female: It's you! You can't fool me that easily!

say:6:1121215002:0.text: The jig is up, time for plan B.
say:6:1121215002:0.source_cn: 还是暴露了啊，没办法，应战吧。

say:8:1121215003:0.text: Aves 11, it's time to avenge Illucia! Kill them!
say:8:1121215003:0.source_cn: 阿尔法十一，快干掉他们，为伊露西卡女士报仇！

say:10:1121215005:0.text: I'm sure Mother is alive... She wouldn't have been defeated by them!
say:10:1121215005:0.source_cn: 妈妈还活着，妈妈不会输给他们的。

say:13:1121215006:0.source_cn: 妈妈？那女孩口中的妈妈难道是——

say:14:1121215007:0.source_cn: 喂！不要松懈，她攻过来了！

narration:16:11021222:0.text: The mysterious girl muttered about her mother. Your cover was blown by the Syndicate, and she attacked you on their command!
narration:16:11021222:0.source_cn: 陌生的少女念叨着她的妈妈。你的伪装被黑金残党识破，少女...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1121211001:.text: Damn... Aves 11, you're not working hard enough!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1121211001:.source_cn: 可恶……阿尔法十一！你不够努力！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1121211002:.text: Do you want to save Illucia or not?!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1121211002:.source_cn: 你还想不想救伊露西卡女士！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1121217001:.text: Your companions have abandoned you! Surrender at once!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1121217001:.source_cn: 你被同伴抛弃了！束手就擒吧！
